<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914333_theRebbe_315" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914333_theRebbe_315__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the superiority of the incense service over sacrifices, as it refines even the lowest sparks and intentional sins become merits, indicating a higher source.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, one can understand more deeply the greatness of the elevation of the service of the incense over the service of the sacrifices,</t>
    <t s="2">for through the service of the incense, even the sparks that fell into the three completely impure klipot are refined,</t>
    <t s="3">and even intentional sins become as merits,</t>
    <t s="4">and since whatever fell to the very lowest place indicates that its source is on the very highest level,</t>
    <t s="5">it is therefore understood77</t>
    <t s="6">that these sparks</t>
    <t s="7">(that fell into the three completely impure klipot and particularly into intentional sins)</t>
    <t s="8">are from a level higher even than the sparks and physical things</t>
    <t s="9">(that are permitted)</t>
    <t s="10">that are refined through the service of the sacrifices.</t>
    <t s="11">That is, within tohu itself, they are on a more elevated level.</t>
    <t s="12">For this is what our sages, of blessed memory, said:78</t>
    <t s="13">"In the place where penitents stand, even the completely righteous cannot stand,"</t>
    <t s="14">because penitents refine from the three completely impure klipot, while the completely righteous refine only from nogah.79</t>
    <t s="15">And this is also that the revelations of the Future to Come depend</t>
    <t s="16">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="17">upon our deeds and service during the time of exile80</t>
    <t s="18">specifically</t>
    <t s="19">[and within the time of exile itself, in the period of the heels of Mashiach],</t>
    <t s="20">for the main aspect of the eleven klipot of impurity is during the time of exile</t>
    <t s="21">[and particularly in the heels of Mashiach],</t>
    <t s="22">and therefore through our deeds and service during the time of exile, we draw down an unlimited light,</t>
    <t s="23">"These are the generations of Peretz"81</t>
    <t s="24">"generations" is written in full,82</t>
    <t s="25">which is more elevated even than the "generations" written in full that was at the time of creation83</t>
    <t s="26">("These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created"84),</t>
    <t s="27">for the world was created in its fullness.85</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section discusses the superiority of the Yom Kippur incense over the year-round incense, as it involves teshuvah that turns sins into merits, reaching the inner aspect of Atik.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is also the superiority of the incense of Yom Kippur over the incense of the entire year,</t>
    <t s="1">for the incense of Yom Kippur is the matter of teshuvah, where intentional sins become as merits86</t>
    <t s="2">[for the service of Yom Kippur is in the aspect of Yechidah of the soul,</t>
    <t s="3">and this means that within the Ten Days of Repentance themselves</t>
    <t s="4">(here, for an individual)</t>
    <t s="5">the main revelation</t>
    <t s="6">(and service)</t>
    <t s="7">of the aspect of Yechidah is on Yom Kippur, once a year,87</t>
    <t s="8">and that intentional sins become actual merits is through the service of the aspect of Yechidah],</t>
    <t s="9">and this matter</t>
    <t s="10">[that intentional sins are transformed into merits]</t>
    <t s="11">reaches the inner aspect of Atik.86</t>
    <t s="12">And this matter also pertains to Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="13">as is known88</t>
    <t s="14">that on Yom Kippur there is the ascent of Malchus to the aspect of Atik.</t>
    <t s="15">And this also serves as a preparation and preface for the revelation of the Future to Come</t>
    <t s="16">[which will also be specifically through the service of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="17">as the statement89</t>
    <t s="18">"Mashiach comes to bring the righteous back in teshuvah"],</t>
    <t s="19">for then there will be the revelation of the inner aspect of Atik.90</t>
  </section>
  <section v="11">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that all elevations achieved through service in this world were already potentially present in the soul before its descent, and are actualized through specific mitzvos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, all the above elevations that are accomplished in the soul specifically through service in this world,</t>
    <t s="2">and within this world itself during the time of exile,</t>
    <t s="3">were also in it before its descent.</t>
    <t s="4">As is understood from the teaching of the Maggid of Mezeritch91</t>
    <t s="5">in explaining the statement of our sages, of blessed memory:66</t>
    <t s="6">"Israel arose in thought,"</t>
    <t s="7">which is like the parable of a son whose form is engraved in the father's thought,</t>
    <t s="8">and since for the Holy One, blessed be He, past and future are one, therefore even before Israel was created, their form was engraved in thought.</t>
    <t s="9">From this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="10">that also the elevation that is accomplished in the soul through its descent from a high roof to a deep pit and its service there in the aspect of the depth and innerness of the heart,</t>
    <t s="11">and within this itself, on the most elevated level</t>
    <t s="12">(the essence of the point of the heart)92,</t>
    <t s="13">through which it is elevated higher than it was in its source in the aspect of "the G-d who gave it,"93</t>
    <t s="14">this form as well</t>
    <t s="15">(of the son,</t>
    <t s="16">as he is in ultimate perfection)</t>
    <t s="17">was engraved in His thought, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="18">However, this is in potential,</t>
    <t s="19">and in order for this elevation to be in actuality,94</t>
    <t s="20">this is accomplished through its descent below and its actual service in the study of Torah and the fulfillment of the commandments,</t>
    <t s="21">and particularly through the service of the incense of Yom Kippur, which is the service of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="22">and through sitting in the sukkah and taking the four species, through which the drawing down and revelation of the encompassing light of the cloud of incense of Yom Kippur is accomplished.</t>
    <t s="23">And likewise in the days between Yom Kippur and Sukkos,</t>
    <t s="24">"this one is occupied with his sukkah and this one with his lulav."95</t>
    <t s="25">For this is the reason that the first day of Sukkos is the beginning of the reckoning of sins,96</t>
    <t s="26">because during these four days all of Israel are occupied</t>
    <t s="27">(only)</t>
    <t s="28">with commandments,</t>
    <t s="29">and consequently it is not possible that they do anything undesirable.</t>
    <t s="30">And it is understood,</t>
    <t s="31">that when these four days are as they should be, then even after the reckoning begins,</t>
    <t s="32">it is in an entirely different manner,</t>
    <t s="33">in the manner of the known matter regarding what even the completely righteous say "on a sin,"97</t>
    <t s="34">"sin" being a term of deficiency,98</t>
    <t s="35">in the most subtle of subtleties.</t>
    <t s="36">And what is said "the beginning of the reckoning of sins," the intention is not for sins in their simple sense</t>
    <t s="37">(including also one who has the ability to protest and does not protest99)</t>
    <t s="38">but rather for sins in the sense of distortion and crookedness,</t>
    <t s="39">and even this does not apply,</t>
    <t s="40">and distortion and crookedness is in the ultimate subtlety,</t>
    <t s="41">and as explained above100</t>
    <t s="42">in the explanation of the verse101</t>
    <t s="43">"for you have stumbled in your iniquity."</t>
    <t s="44">And through this,</t>
    <t s="45">the incense of Yom Kippur as well,</t>
    <t s="46">whose matter is teshuvah where intentional sins are transformed into merits,</t>
    <t s="47">is also for sins</t>
    <t s="48">(and intentional sins)</t>
    <t s="49">that are in the ultimate subtlety.</t>
    <t s="50">And after Yom Kippur, they draw down the aspect of the encompassing light of the cloud of incense into the matters of sukkah and lulav, as they are still things of permission and Israel prepares and readies them for a mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="51">and particularly after they fulfill with them the mitzvah of sitting in the sukkah and taking the four species on the festival of Sukkos, the time of our rejoicing,</t>
    <t s="52">and joy is drawn down for the entire year,102</t>
    <t s="53">a constant joy,103</t>
    <t s="54">that they serve G-d constantly with joy and a good heart,104</t>
    <t s="55">and this becomes a close preparation for "everlasting joy upon their heads"105</t>
    <t s="56">that will be in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Mashiach,</t>
    <t s="57">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="58">speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
